subject: gk
question:
With reference to the All India Inter-Club U21 Men & Women Water Polo League - 2025, which of the following statements are accurate?

1. The tournament was hosted at Mayo College in Ajmer, Rajasthan.

2. It was organized under the aegis of the Western Naval Command.

3. The event took place from 14 to 18 April 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The All India Inter-Club U21 Men & Women Water Polo League - 2025 was hosted at **Mayo College in Ajmer, Rajasthan**.
 
• The event took place from **14 to 18 April 2025**, making this information accurate as per the question.
 
• However, the statement regarding the organization of the event under the aegis of the **Western Naval Command** is incorrect, as it was not associated with this authority.
 
• Thus, only statements 1 and 3 are accurate, aligning with the question and confirming Option 3 as the correct choice.
 
• The league aimed to promote water polo at the grassroots level, offering young athletes a platform to showcase their talent and develop their skills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Water Polo in India**

 
 
• Water polo is a growing sport in India, with increasing attention being given to grassroots development and youth participation.
 
• Events like the All India Inter-Club U21 Men & Women Water Polo League aim to provide a platform for young athletes to compete at a national level and gain exposure.
 
• Such tournaments also help identify talent for international competitions, fostering the growth of aquatic sports in the country.
